description: This file defines a struct ExecCommandResolution that handles resolving command paths, parsing shell command chains, tokenizing shell words, and generating display strings for executable commands. It encapsulates logic related to command resolution, shell parsing, and command pattern matching within the project.

classes.name: ExecCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates command resolution details, including raw executable, resolved path, and executable name, with static methods for resolving commands and parsing shell command chains.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main entry point for resolving a command array and raw command string to an ExecCommandResolution object.

methods.name: resolveForAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves commands for allowlist purposes, handling shell wrappers and command segments.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Collects patterns for commands that are always allowed without prompts.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves an executable path from a raw executable string, expanding tilde and resolving via PATH.

methods.name: resolveShellSegmentExecutable
methods.description: Resolves executable from a shell command segment.

methods.name: collectAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively collects allowlist patterns from command sequences.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Detects and unwraps shell multiplexers like busybox or toybox to retrieve the actual command segments.

methods.name: parseFirstToken
methods.description: Parses and extracts the first token from a command string.

methods.name: tokenizeShellWords
methods.description: Tokenizes a shell command string into an array of individual shell words, respecting quotes and escapes.

methods.name: splitShellCommandChain
methods.description: Splits a shell command chain into separate segments, considering quoting, escaping, and control operators.
